review_scope.excludes: No linked-paper recursive import, code reproduction, target-model performance trial, or formal proof certification.

chapter_review.conclusion: The existing chapter correctly treats eviction as approximation and does not claim universal quality or transfer paper speedups. Add operational and evidence boundaries; no existing theorem is used as a correctness oracle.

findings.fact: Main text divides a total budget between heavy hitters and recent tokens; Appendix A uses k for each partition, totalling 2k. Evaluation ratios are described relative to prompt length.
findings.action: Name B_H, B_R, total B and percentage denominator, and distinguish fixed capacity from a growing current-history percentage.

findings.locations: Appendix A pp.18–19; Appendix B.2 p.20
findings.fact: Preallocated cache and recent circular queue avoid general compaction; implementation describes per-head eviction. Cumulative scores favour older entries, and averaging degraded reported task performance.
findings.action: Preserve logical positions, score identities and slot generations; explicitly design score exposure and GQA shared-KV selection rather than copying per-query-head allocation.

findings.fact: Reported sparsity counts entries below 1% of each row maximum; it is threshold-defined, not exact zero.
findings.action: Do not infer 20x exact compression or quality from the sparsity percentage; validate dropped mass, output effects and future dependence.

findings.locations: §5.2 pp.8–9; Appendix A p.18; Appendix C.2 p.22
findings.fact: Synthetic padded equal lengths and fixed generation counts are used for throughput; denominator includes prefill+decode. Some OPT long-context measurements exceed training context and are explicitly speed potential tests. C.2 throughput compression is of weights via FlexGen.
findings.action: Retain workload and quality separation; do not describe these as measured online-tail latency or arbitrary KV quantization combinations.

findings.locations: PDF p.37 Definition D.28 and Lemma D.29, also p.38 Lemma D.30
findings.observation: D.28 states opt_i >= (1-gamma) opt_(i-1); the induction condition states opt_i >= (1-gamma) opt_(i+1). These constrain opposite time directions.
findings.action: Treat theorem as source-reported under explicit conditions; do not certify its printed proof or use it as an output-quality oracle.

findings.locations: PDF p.42 Lemma D.44 Part 4 versus Part 5
findings.observation: Part 4 gives the standard softmax derivative with a negative f f^T component; Part 5 prints a positive component for the squared-error gradient.
findings.action: Do not copy the printed formula; correct gradient is A^T[diag(f)-f f^T](f-b). This is in auxiliary sparsity-loss analysis, not evidence that runtime eviction code is wrong.

source_note_update.coverage: 固定 v1 描述累计 attention 与近期 token 的预算拆分、按 head 的淘汰与环形槽更新，评估不同模型/任务，并在附录给出实现、合成吞吐设置和带条件的评分函数分析。
source_note_update.derivation: 将当前可见历史的近似保留与跨请求缓存淘汰分开；明确预算分母、每 head/GQA 组合、评分与整理开销，并按实际设置连接数值、质量和系统测量。
source_note_update.limitations: 经验稀疏性由每行 max 的 1% 阈值定义，不是严格零或无损保证。附录局部公式/条件存在已视觉核对的打印不一致，全文复核不等于其数学保证已形式化认证。合成等长性能实验和超 OPT 训练上下文的速度测试不能当作目标长期质量证据；附录 C.2 主要为权重压缩吞吐。
source_note_update.locations: 完整阅读 PDF pp.1–10 主文、pp.17–27 附录目录/实现/限制/实验、pp.28–45 理论附录 D.1–D.22。pp.11–16 为参考文献列表，不递归导入所引文献。p.37、p.42、p.44 已视觉核对。
